Subject: Next steps: demo & evaluation plan — HealthMetric trial slate

Hi Asha — thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can get a trial started quickly.

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary use case: automated triage + prioritization for RN intake; target 60–120ms per inference in production.
- Data footprint: ~10M historical transcripts (PII-redacted), batch export available via S3.
- Success metrics: F1 on triage labels >= 0.78, average latency <120ms at 8k RPS simulation, and no PII exfiltration in evaluation prompts.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive / demo w/ engineering and DevOps (30–45m) — review trial plan, integration approach, and prompt set.
2) Evaluation kickoff (1h) — align success criteria, hand off prompt pack and initial eval script, confirm data access & security scoping.

Suggested windows (PST) next week — please pick one that works for your team:
- Tue 5/11 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 5/12 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu 5/13 11:00–12:00

Attachments: I attached a short draft trial_plan_v1.pdf (3 pages) and a sample prompt CSV (prompt_set_sample_v1.csv) so your team can skim before the call.

Prework for the technical deep dive
- DevOps: confirm whether we can provision a read-only S3 bucket or temporary dataset export (note in reply).
- Engineering: a short list of integration questions (we’ll capture these on the call).

If you prefer, we can split the demo and kickoff into two back-to-back slots (demo 30m + kickoff 30m). Let me know what you prefer and which window fits.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
